fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: Duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The top-level error message, or `null` if there was no top-level error.
